source_review.finding: The -S handler checks length and emptiness. Socket-name construction copies the supplied name without tab normalization; slash handling is separate.
FindSocket emits one literal tab before the name, timestamp and state. A name ending with tabs therefore retains those bytes before the timestamp separator.

scope: Real command body with controlled producer output; this is not a live GNU Screen daemon test. No Flutter/Dart or GitHub CI process was run.
